blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Quezon City Police District (QCPD) is investigating a viral video showing a reported commotion outside the Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) in Quezon City on Monday. The scene reportedly involves a person who identified himself as a media worker, allegedly used profanity and kicked several cops. “Initial reports indicate that a verbal altercation occurred involving an individual who identified himself as a member of the media and deployed police personnel,” said the QCPD in a statement on Tuesday. “The individual allegedly uttered profane remarks and kicked several police personnel,” added the QCPD.
